In this video, we go back to ancient Greece, and see some of the incredible techology they used over 2000 years ago.

We'll see the Polybolos, an ancient repeating crossbow often described as the first machine gun. A flamethrower used in battle. Plato's water-powered alarm clock. The Diolkos, a stone trackway used to transport ships across land. The Helepolis, a gigantic nine-storey siege tower, and Archimedes' Claw, a weapon designed to lift and overturn enemy warships.
